thread:
jana: Brought mistral-lite-v1 to canary and ran the multilingual onboarding suite. Seeing a locale-specific regression on JP+AR mixed-orientation tests after int8 quant — BLEU down ~2.9 vs fp16 and detokenization inserting invisible separators inside ruby (furigana). Also Arabic parentheses sometimes appear outside the Arabic span (mirrored).

oliver: Ugh. Minimal repro?

jana: Input we used (from mix-orient subset):
```
日本語(漢字《ふりがな》) と Arabic (مرحبا)
```
int8 model output (truncated):
```
日本語(漢字《ふりがな》) と Arabic )مرحبا(
```
Note the U+200B (ZWSP) between kana in the furigana and the parentheses order. fp16 baseline is clean.

nora: Eval stats?

eval-bot: [automated] job=7990001111-A subset=mix-orient BLEU(fp16)=29.6 BLEU(int8)=26.7 chrF(fp16)=0.61 chrF(int8)=0.58 sample_mismatch=58/500

lucy: Can you dump the raw UTF-8 bytes from the decoder buffer around the ruby brackets? Also run token_inspect on the furigana span for both fp16 and int8.

jana: Hex snippet from int8 decode buffer: `e3 81 a5 e3 81 8b e2 80 8b e3 81 8c e3 81 aa` (shows 0xE2 0x80 0x8B = U+200B). fp16 run does not include these bytes. token_inspect results: fp16 tokens around furigana -> [5123, 78, 332]; int8 -> [5123, 999, 78, 332] (id 999 maps to ZWSP/space token).

oliver: If ZWSP gets emitted as a token it will survive detok and cause spacing oddities; parentheses mirroring result suggests a bidi step applied after detok that sees different logical order. Quant shouldn't change tokenizer. Hypotheses: (1) decode buffer alignment/optimisation in runtime introduced stray bytes on certain kernels, (2) quant rounding pushed logits to pick a ZWSP token at a merge boundary, (3) decoding tie-break differences under quant.

nora: Runtime note: we merged `decode_buffer_align` optimization in runtime-2024-11-29 which touches memcpy/unpack around decode kernels. If that produced stray bytes it's likely the culprit.

lucy: I quickly re-ran int8 with `--decode-alignment=off` flag and ZWSP disappears; output matches fp16. That pins it to the runtime alignment path.

jana: Good repro. Plan I'm putting in the triage ticket: (A) attach minimal repro sample + token_inspect + hex dump, (B) bisect runtime commits runtime-2024-11-20..runtime-2024-12-02 focusing on decode_buffer_align, (C) add unit test asserting no ASCII/ZWSP bytes inserted between UTF-8 multibyte sequences for mixed-orientation strings, (D) pin canary runtime to pre-2024-11-29 until fix.

oliver: Also add quick eval across q4_0/q5_0/int4 to see quant-sensitivity; if other quant modes are fine we can prioritize guarding the unsafe optimized path for int8.

nora: I'll open the runtime bisect PR and a small CI test. runtime-bot: please suggest temporary mitigation flags and image pins.

runtime-bot: Suggested mitigation: image pin to runtime@sha256:oldalign123 and start canary with `--decode-alignment=off`. Will create a rollback note.

jana: Uploading repro tar to ticket now (includes 200 samples, token_inspect outputs, and hex dumps). Will update here when bisect yields a suspect commit. :thumbsup:
